defect: The fix additionally forces non-mip filtering when texlevel requests a fixed level 0 (noMip), so text no longer disappears with mipmapping ON in Tactics Ogre.
reason: The change only added the bMipMap-off path; the missing-text problem occurs with mipmapping enabled, which was the behaviour before the change.

defect: CreateCodeList allocates enableCheat with new bool[] on every call (including the newly added call in OnBack) and never frees it, leaking memory.
reason: The fix adds delete[] enableCheat; the heap allocation replacing the former static array was introduced by this change.

defect: The fix removes the private member std::vector<int> locations, which had become unused.
reason: Removing an unused member is a cleanup, not the repair of a defect.

defect: canDiscardVertex is true when the BROKEN_NAN_IN_CONDITIONAL bug is present instead of when it is absent, inverting the previous !Has(...) check.
reason: The fix adds the missing negation to the line this change wrote; the old code had the check the right way round.

defect: The fix widens ALL_FLAGS to 0x07FFFFFF to cover REGALLOC_GPR/REGALLOC_FPR.
reason: 0x01FFFFFF covered every flag when this change was made; the REGALLOC bits were added later by 6fd40332fd without updating ALL_FLAGS.

defect: The fix uses a fixed size for the first background-audio read (lastPlaybackTime 0) and only advances lastPlaybackTime after a read, removing static at the start.
reason: This change only added an int cast to the comparison; the first-read size logic it repairs existed before.

defect: angle = toLight.Normalize() * lightDir.Normalize() multiplies the two lengths returned by Normalize() instead of taking the dot product of the normalized vectors, so the spotlight cone test is wrong.
reason: The fix switches to Normalized() on the exact line this change added; seeing that Normalize() returns a float length needs Math3D.h.

defect: wsbw (0xE0) emits IROp::BSwap16 instead of BSwap32, a copy-paste of the wsbh case.
reason: The fix changes exactly that line of this new file to BSwap32.

defect: The 0xD address-compare code computes addr2 with GetAddress(arg & 0xFFFFFFFF), keeping the code-type nibble (4-7) in the address instead of masking with 0x0FFFFFFF.
reason: The fix corrects the mask on the line this change added; comm is masked with 0x0FFFFFFF right above it.

defect: The fix moves the npdrm logging to the sceIo channel and reworks logging after __IoIoctl stopped logging like an HLE function; it also changes retval != 0 to retval < 0.
reason: The fix is a logging cleanup tied to sceIo.cpp; the retval != 0 check predates this change, which only rewrote log calls.

defect: The fix replaces the raw ljoy/rjoy axis-only joystick code with the SDLJoystick class and its event processing.
reason: SDL joystick support was broken by 935165ca69 (eight minutes earlier), which removed SDLJoystick; this change only uncommented the axis code, partly restoring input.

defect: Int_Vsocp clamps with std::min/std::max, which turn a NaN input into 0 instead of preserving NaN as the PSP VFPU does.
reason: The fix replaces those clamps in the vsocp code this change added with NaN-preserving nanclamp; that the hardware keeps NaN is not visible from the code.

defect: IniFile::Load breaks on in.eof() before processing the line just read, so a last line without a trailing newline is ignored and deleted on resave.
reason: The file is added by this change and the fix removes that early eof break from its Load loop.

defect: onVKeyDown/onVKeyUp are called with key.keyCode instead of the virtual key code result, so the VIRTKEY_UNTHROTTLE switch never matches.
reason: The fix passes result on the lines this change added; the mismatch is visible against the switch in the same diff.

defect: The fix escapes the ??? in a log string because ??) is a trigraph, silencing a compiler warning.
reason: A warning fix in a log message string, not a functional defect.

defect: The fix declares vfb_byteWidth as int to silence a signed/unsigned comparison warning against the int size.
reason: Values are small and the comparison behaves correctly; this is a warning cleanup.

defect: The fix removes an unused static MaskedEqual helper and adds a GE_FORMAT_INVALID case to silence switch warnings.
reason: Warning cleanup; the added case is documented as impossible.

defect: The fix adds (u32) casts to the needShaderTexClamp width/height comparison to silence a signed/unsigned warning.
reason: Texture sizes are small positive values, so the comparison was already correct; warning cleanup only.

defect: The fix uses the pixel size instead of the render size for the viewport when buffered rendering is off, and normalizes include paths.
reason: The non-buffered mode (bBufferedRendering) and the active viewport code came in later commits; this reorganization did not contain that logic.

defect: The fix changes the portrait tablet resolution and TABLET env parsing, plus whitespace in lines this change touched.
reason: The change only added log lines and two key mappings; the zoom/resolution logic the fix repairs was not part of it.

defect: __AudioDoState re-registers the AudioUpdateHost event with hleAudioUpdate instead of hleHostAudioUpdate, breaking host audio updates after a savestate load.
reason: The fix corrects the callback on the line this change added; __AudioInit in the same diff registers hleHostAudioUpdate.

defect: The fix makes EndFrame end whatever render pass is current (EndCurrentRenderpass) instead of always the surface render pass.
reason: At this change only the surface render pass existed; framebuffer render passes and curRenderPass_ arrived in later commits, which created the mismatch.

defect: The fix moves the dual-source-blending vendor bug check into Draw's bug flags.
reason: A refactor of the bug-check mechanism; this change only renamed the config variable.

defect: The fix orders the yes/no buttons by platform convention in the portrait layout and simplifies the default focus.
reason: A UI-convention adjustment of the new layout rather than the repair of a functional defect.

defect: The fix replaces std::pair<SceUID, u32> with a POD struct for VPL waiting threads so PointerWrap's new is_pod check accepts it.
reason: Serializing the pair worked in practice; the fix adapts to the stricter POD check added later in 806907e2cc/82a8450758.

defect: The decrypted EBOOT dump writes head->elf_size bytes instead of the decrypted length returned by pspDecryptPRX.
reason: The fix replaces the length on the dump call this change added; knowing that ret is the real decrypted size needs PrxDecrypter.

defect: The new _assert_ calls use JitState::PREFIX_KNOWN in the ARM JIT, which has ArmJitState, so debug/iOS ARM builds fail to compile.
reason: The fix changes those two added lines to ArmJitState; the same diff uses ArmJitState::PREFIX_KNOWN_DIRTY elsewhere.

defect: KernelLoadExecParam reads the PSP struct, whose argp/key fields are host pointers, with ReadStruct and casts them to u32, which truncates pointers and mis-sizes the struct on 64-bit (clang error).
reason: Earlier code never read these fields; the fix turns them into u32 guest addresses and copies into separate host buffers.

defect: The added sprintf passes controllerMaps.size() (size_t) to a %i conversion, undefined behaviour on 64-bit.
reason: The fix adds an (int) cast to exactly this sprintf line introduced by the change.

defect: vfpu_sin/vfpu_cos/vfpu_sincos reduce the angle with floorf(angle*4)*0.25 instead of floorf(angle*0.25)*4, giving wrong results for most inputs.
reason: The fix corrects the range reduction in the three functions this change added; the period of sin(x*pi/2) is 4.

defect: EXPECT_EQ_FLOAT concatenates the integer __LINE__ into its format string literal; the fix prints it with %i.
reason: The old macro already concatenated __LINE__ the same way; this change kept that pre-existing mistake.

defect: ShowLeaderboardSubmitted shows the message as MESSAGE_SUCCESS instead of the LEADERBOARD_SUBMITTED type this change introduced, so type-based handling (ClearAchievementStuff, later per-type customization) misses it.
reason: The fix changes exactly that added line to LEADERBOARD_SUBMITTED; the change itself lists that type in ClearAchievementStuff but never uses it.

defect: The fix adds a same-size bonus to the focus direction score so the next list item is preferred over the top bar.
reason: A tuning of the navigation heuristic for a minor case, not the repair of a fault in the lines this change wrote.

defect: The fix rewrites the GuessDrawingSize heuristic this change wrote, which produced wrong FBO sizes for some render-to-texture games.
reason: The rewritten code is this change's, but it is a heuristic replacement and the repository does not show whether those games were already sized wrongly before the change.

defect: The fix stops attaching an exact-address framebuffer whose format differs from the texture.
reason: Before this change such framebuffers were attached too (as valid); the change only marked them invalid, so the attachment the fix removes predates it.

defect: A static const array stores pointers to this instance's categoryToggles_, initialized only once, so later ControlMappingScreen instances use dangling pointers.
reason: The fix removes the pointers from the static array and indexes categoryToggles_ directly; the static-plus-member-pointer pattern is in the change's diff.

defect: In the texture preview, the VAO/buffer rebinding with an offset-0 attribute pointer sits in the indexed branch, so it runs even without VAO support and is skipped for non-indexed VAO draws.
reason: The fix moves that block, which this change added while debugging, into the texPreviewVao != 0 branch.

defect: The re-added 2x mouse coordinate factor still applies when the window is maximized from 1x size, since only bFullScreen and iWindowWidth are checked.
reason: The fix adds !IsZoomed to the factor line this change added; that iWindowWidth is not updated on maximize is outside the diff.

defect: The fix only adds the run-behind setting to a debug assert message.
reason: A diagnostics change; nothing in the change's logic is repaired.

defect: The fix validates vagAddr before starting the VAG decoder in KeyOn and dispatches Mix by voice type.
reason: The unchecked vag.Start(Memory::GetPointer(vagAddr)) existed before in sceSas.cpp and KeyOn moved into this file later; dispatch by vagAddr also came from the old mix code.
